name: 48823 · East Lansing, MI
findings: ZIP 48823 (East Lansing) has 265 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 121 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48823 (East Lansing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48823 (East Lansing) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: No arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
